founder_peer.name: Founder-to-Founder Collaboration
founder_peer.description: Used when the sender is a founder building an adjacent product in the same ecosystem.
founder_peer.bridge_formula: We are building [User Startup] ([User Product One-Liner]) and noticed a great synergy between our [User Value Prop] and what you have built with [Company Name]. Would love to connect and exchange notes.

partnership_integration.name: Technical Co-Marketing & Integration
partnership_integration.description: Propose an API integration, ecosystem partnership, or co-marketing initiative between two products.
partnership_integration.bridge_formula: We are building [User Startup] and see a natural workflow pairing between [User Value Prop] and how engineers use [Company Name]. Would love to explore a joint integration.

review_media.name: Review & Media Feature
review_media.description: Invite the startup to be featured in an upcoming category roundup, benchmark, or directory.
review_media.bridge_formula: We are putting together an upcoming [Category] benchmark and would love to feature [Company Name].

investor_scout.name: Investor & Scout Inquiry
investor_scout.description: Engage founders for early-stage scouting, funding updates, or portfolio review.
investor_scout.bridge_formula: We actively scout high-momentum early-stage founders in [Category] and would love to learn more about your roadmap.

founder_feedback.name: Peer Builder Product Feedback
founder_feedback.description: Engage indie founders and peer builders with authentic product testing feedback.
founder_feedback.bridge_formula: Currently testing early tooling in the [Category] space and wanted to share a couple UX observations with you directly.
